keyEvents.text: Delay in match (LA Galaxy).
Delay in match because of an injury Ilie Sánchez (Austin FC).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! LA Galaxy 1, Austin FC 0. João Klauss (LA Galaxy) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Harbor Tarczynski-Miller.
Besard Sabovic (Austin FC) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! LA Galaxy 2, Austin FC 0. Hirving Lozano (LA Galaxy) header from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Marco Reus with a cross.
Substitution, LA Galaxy. Robert Taylor replaces Hirving Lozano.
Goal! LA Galaxy 3, Austin FC 0. Robert Taylor (LA Galaxy) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the top left corner. Assisted by Marco Reus.
Goal! LA Galaxy 3, Austin FC 1. Ervin Torres (Austin FC) right footed shot from outside the box to the top right corner. Assisted by Micah Burton.
Substitution, LA Galaxy. Lucas Sanabria replaces Pablo Ruiz.
Substitution, Austin FC. Zan Kolmanic replaces Przemyslaw Placheta.
Goal! LA Galaxy 4, Austin FC 1. Sergi Roberto (LA Galaxy) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the top left corner. Assisted by Marco Reus with a headed pass.
Substitution, LA Galaxy. Jakob Glesnes replaces Emiro Garcés.
Substitution, LA Galaxy. Erik Thommy replaces Sergi Roberto.
Substitution, Austin FC. Oleksandr Svatok replaces Ilie Sánchez.
Substitution, Austin FC. Joseph Rosales replaces Micah Burton.
Delay in match because of an injury Joseph Rosales (Austin FC).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, LA Galaxy. Calegari replaces Harbor Tarczynski-Miller.
Substitution, Austin FC. Riley Thomas replaces Guilherme Biro.
Substitution, Austin FC. Facundo Torres replaces Besard Sabovic.
Marco Reus (LA Galaxy) is shown the yellow card.
Zan Kolmanic (Austin FC) is shown the red card.
Second Half ends, LA Galaxy 4, Austin FC 1.
